messages:
marie: Quick sync ": we need a unified onboarding checklist for US/UK/DE hires. Include handbook refs, required trainings, and hiring-ops CSV header. Target: Confluence template + CSV by Friday.

dan: I'll draft the CSV header. Propose: email,full_name,engagement_type,role,team,location,start_date,handbook_refs,required_courses,manager_approval_needed,notes

lina: Contractors only need DP and SEC baseline. Employees get HB-OVERVIEW plus role-triggered courses. Added a 'required_by_engagement' column to the sheet.

owen: For DE hires we must surface works council notification step. Add local_action=works_council_notice. Also EOR checkbox in hiring form to auto-set engagement_type=EOR.

hr-bot: Reminder set: "Assign onboarding courses within 48h" next run 2026-06-10 09:00 UTC.

marie: Action items:
- dan: CSV header + sample row (48h)
- lina: update spreadsheet with handbook IDs per country (24h)
- owen: add EOR flag to hiring form and DE local action note (48h)

dan: I'll post the CSV sample to Confluence when ready.

lina: Uploading handbook refs now. Use IDs like US-HB-3.1, UK-HB-1B, DE-HB-2.0.

owen: I'll coordinate with legal on works council wording.

marie: Keep comments on the Confluence page not here. Closing thread once Confluence template exists. :white_check_mark:
